name: Always Answered
who: Plumbers, electricians, dental and physio practices, salons and repair shops with one to fifteen staff, where the person who answers the phone is also the person doing the work.
problem: "Half the calls come in while I'm under a sink. By the time I ring back they've booked someone else. I've advertised for a receptionist twice this year and got nobody worth interviewing."
solution: We run the answering for them. An AI voice and web assistant picks up every call and enquiry within seconds, answers the standard questions, books the appointment in their calendar and texts them a summary. We configure it in their words, monitor it weekly and fix what it gets wrong.
promise: You cannot hire a receptionist, and every missed call is a job somebody else got. Every call and every web enquiry answered within seconds and booked into your diary, for less than a tenth of what a receptionist costs.
gets:
A voice assistant answering your number and your web form, in your business's own words
Appointments written straight into the calendar you already use, plus a text summary of every call
A monthly report of calls answered, jobs booked, and what callers asked that we could not yet answer
positioning: Sold as the receptionist they cannot hire, not as AI. Priced monthly against a salary, and set up by us rather than handed over as a login.
voice: Trade-floor plain. Talks about missed calls and booked jobs, never about models or automation.
channels: Trade suppliers and wholesalers, local Facebook trade groups, Google search for 'telefoonservice', referral from bookkeepers, door-knocking
